title: ipomoea hederacea var. inaequalis
intro: Ipomoea hederacea var. inaequalis, commonly known as Woodland Morning Glory, is a perennial vine native to North America. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative effects, and it also supports overall health and wellness. The therapeutic actions of Woodland Morning Glory include sedation, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential treatment for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
